audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad copy-paste under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); report[8].t misgenders Janna as 'his' (she/her, per champ-gender list); and the missing-interaction brief flags that Monsoon (R)'s heal needs Grievous Wounds timing, which is never mentioned in prose.

audit.corrected: Cite Howling Gale (Q) cd 14s, fix the two bleed bullets with real content, fix the pronoun, and note anti-heal timing against Monsoon's heal.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. It writes your spacing rules. - E Battle Dance is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Howling Gale (Q) is a 14s cooldown once charged and released — bait the charge before you commit the dive, or the tornado breaks your engage for free. - E Battle Dance is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Monsoon (R) heals through chip once it settles — buy Grievous Wounds before her ult swings a long fight back her way.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Commit your R into a banked Monsoon — the knockback throws you off your target and heals the ally you dove.
